caption: A supply-and-loss map shows why iron deficiency can arise through poor intake, malabsorption or blood loss.
question: Why should iron deficiency prompt consideration of more than dietary intake?
answer: Reduced absorption and blood loss can also lower iron availability for haemoglobin synthesis.
